catalog_change_events_reason_check.name: catalog_change_events_reason_check
catalog_change_events_reason_check.value: ("catalog_change_events"."reason_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_change_events"."change_type_id" IS NOT NULL) OR "catalog_change_events"."kind" = 'observed_other' OR "catalog_change_events"."evidence" = 'backfill' OR "catalog_change_events"."reason_kind" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'backfill'

vendor_routes_serving_needs_terms_check.name: vendor_routes_serving_needs_terms_check
vendor_routes_serving_needs_terms_check.value: "vendor_routes"."state" <> 'serving' OR NOT ("vendor_routes"."capability" IN ('vision.read', 'judge.render', 'image.matte', 'image.upscale', 'ocr.read', 'people.detect')) OR (btrim(coalesce("vendor_routes"."no_training_terms", '')) <> '' AND lower(btrim("vendor_routes"."no_training_terms")) NOT LIKE 'pending%')
